scientific_integrity: The exact asymptotic claims rest on a Gaussian concentration argument, constrained Laplace bounds, and renewal/order-statistic reasoning. A deterministic checker verifies 276 finite coefficient and integral approximations, not universal convergence. Novelty comparison is qualified best knowledge, not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: First-order tail, maximum and selected-duration limits for complete, independent Poisson reset cycles with fully renewed scaled Brownian paths, fixed 0<beta<2 and positive K and r. No centered extreme-value distribution, finite-n error bound, incomplete-cycle result, nonrenewed-clock result, or total-area upper-tail theorem.
title: Exact logarithmic extremes and duration selection for Poisson-reset scaled Brownian area
